title: Critique: for experience, the appearance is the reality

statements.text: Against eliminativism about phenomenal consciousness: the gap between illusion and reality seems to collapse for inner experience. Even if what-it-is-likeness belongs to how introspection represents states, it would be a real feature of introspection, relocated but not removed. As Searle puts it, where consciousness is concerned the existence of the appearance is the reality.
